note: c6 round 3: the 入沢 / 魚町 hillside multi-storey car park (OSM w775150096: amenity=parking, building=parking, parking=multi-storey), GSI lots 16/58540/25068/398 (centre 19.8,-175.0, 519 m2) and 16/58541/25068/31 (centre 31.5,-180.1, 337 m2). The code half is in scripts/anime/enrich/osm.js kindFromTags (building=parking -> kind 'carpark') and src/anime/world/town/carpark.js + mid.js drawCarpark (open decks with a parapet, columns, stall lines and cars painted on the top deck; no windows, no warehouse ribbing). Heights and the number of decks are NOT set here: Earth is 2.5D and no ground photo of the car park exists, so storeys / height stay the derived placeholders (2 decks of 2.8 m) until a ground photo measures them. No parking landuse ring is drawn: landuse paints the ground, which the deck covers, and the stall lines come from the carpark roof painter. The lot 398 grey deck colour (#a8a6a2) is already in c6.json lots/4.
